mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 237.5 indicates accelerating inflation, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to fears of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 237.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous acceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS growth rate exceeds 100k and UNRATE declines by more than 0.2pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion (HOUST > 1200), rising home construction activity signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where HOUST exceeds 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 16200 (annualized) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where GDPC1 is below 16200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 237.5) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) indicates a delayed policy response to inflation, which erodes real returns and triggers equity sell-offs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL > 237.5 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), the tight labor market supports wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
